daily_activities: computer work at the east-wall desk
reading in the northwest lounge corner
room.main_path: Enter through the west-wall door, move east along the unobstructed south-central aisle, then turn northeast through the room center to reach the work chair; short branches serve the south bookcase and northwest reading area.
room.organization: An asymmetric perimeter layout concentrates focused work on the east wall, storage on separate south and northwest walls, and a compact reading group northwest of center.
room.protected_open_space: Keep the west-door clearance, the north-window interior strip, and the broad central-to-south aisle free of furniture so entry, daylight access, chair pullout, and circulation remain unobstructed.

furniture.placement_rationale: The desk is backed against the east wall, outside both opening clearances, with its work front facing west into the room and its long dimension running north-south.
The swivel chair is centered on the desk's west-facing work side, with enough separation for seated use and a direct approach from the open center of the room.
The bookcase occupies a quiet section of the south wall, inset slightly from the boundary and well east of the doorway approach while remaining clear of the primary route to the desk.
The cabinet is backed against the northwest portion of the west wall, north of the door zone and outside the north-window clearance.
The armchair forms an informal reading corner northwest of center and faces diagonally into the room rather than toward its adjacent table or lamp.
The compact square table sits beside the armchair on its west side, within easy reach while remaining separated from the cabinet and circulation route.
The narrow floor lamp stands northeast of the reading chair, close enough to support reading without entering the window clearance or the central walking path.

use_clearance_zones.purpose: Primary seated work zone with clear access from the west side of the desk.
Allows the work chair to roll westward for entry, exit, and repositioning.
Provides unobstructed standing and browsing space along the north-facing shelves.
Keeps the cabinet doors or drawers accessible from the open area to the east.
Preserves an open approach to the reading seat from the room center.

path_targets.purpose: Primary route from the west door through the open center to the work chair.
Maintains direct access to the main work surface from the central aisle.
Branches south from the central aisle to the bookcase browsing zone.
Provides an approach to northwest storage without crossing the reading seat.
Provides a clear diagonal approach from the room center to the reading corner.
